title: First visit shows exactly the 14 default columns in the specified order
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report on a first visit (no saved column selection).
custom_steps: 1. Read the visible column headers left to right without touching the picker.
custom_expected:
1. Exactly these 14 columns show, in this left-to-right order: Type, Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Units Sold, Unit Cost, Sell Price, Revenue, Margin, Margin %, Demand, Last Sale, On Hand.
2. The other 6 columns start hidden: Units Returned, Sold via WO, Sold via Parts Sale, Turns / Yr, Min, Max.
